description:
A client asked for a staged object to be published.

Emitted by the backend through the transactional outbox path (and re-emitted
by the worker's reconciler), consumed by the worker.

dataset_id.description: Dataset the event is about; also the partition key.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

event_id.description: Unique id of this event; consumers deduplicate on it.
event_id.title: Event Id

job_id.description: Publication job the event belongs to.
job_id.title: Job Id

source_key.description: Key of the staged object in the staging bucket.
source_key.title: Source Key

title: PublicationRequested
